urls.rationale: Joint legislative ethics committee - fund; establishes JLEC, the administering body for legislative-agent registration.
Legislative lobbying definitions - definitional anchor for the legislative-agent regime.
Prohibited acts for legislative agents.
Contracts with legislative agents.
Contents of initial registration statement (legislative agent).
Disqualification as legislative agent for certain offenses.
Statements of expenditures (legislative agent).
Statement of financial transactions (legislative agent).
Filing complaint with joint legislative ethics committee.
Efforts excepted from coverage.
Prohibition against contingent fees.
Initial registration, statement of expenditures and financial transactions to be public.
Investigation of violations.
Contempt of the general assembly - enforcement provision cross-referenced from the lobbying chapter.
Retirement system lobbyists and employers - definitions (parallel lobbying-disclosure regime).
Retirement system lobbyists - registration and filing requirements.
Retirement system lobbyists - registration statements - fee - review.
Disqualification as retirement system lobbyist for certain offenses.
Retirement system lobbyists - statement of expenditures - receipts retained.
Retirement system lobbyists - statement of financial transactions.
Retirement system lobbyists - complaint involving dispute.

Retirement system lobbyists - conflicts of interest.
Retirement system lobbyists - statements as public records - list of registrants.
Retirement system lobbyists - attorney general may investigate compliance.
Penalty for Chapter 101 lobbying violations.

notes: Chapter 101 contains two lobbying-disclosure regimes: legislative agents (101.70-101.81) and retirement-system lobbyists (101.90-101.981), plus JLEC fund (101.34) and chapter penalty (101.99).
